untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, SharpLsp ignores workspace-provided settings that select which executable to run (server/sidecar/debug-adapter paths and extra server arguments) and runs only the bundled, vetted binaries. Grant workspace trust to use custom executable paths.

sharplsp.profiler.sampleRate.description: Sampling rate in Hz for CPU profiling (1-1000).

sharplsp.profiler.includeNative.description: Include native frames in profile results.

sharplsp.profiler.lineThreshold.description: Minimum percentage of total samples for a line to appear as a hotspot (0.1-100).

sharplsp.profiler.functionThreshold.description: Minimum percentage of total samples for a function to appear as a hotspot (0.1-100).

sharplsp.profiler.maxDiagnosticsPerFile.description: Maximum number of profiling diagnostics per file.

sharplsp.profiler.showInlineHeatMap.description: Show inline heat map decorations for hot lines after profiling.

sharplsp.profiler.profileOnLaunch.description: Automatically start CPU profiling when a debug session launches.

sharplsp.profiler.processRefreshMs.description: Poll interval (ms) for refreshing the Processes panel while it is visible.

enumDescriptions: Short burst: 10 seconds at 100 Hz, for quick hotspot checks
Thorough: 60 seconds at 200 Hz, higher-fidelity data
No time limit at 50 Hz, for long-running servers and batch jobs
sharplsp.profiler.preset.description: Profiling preset that configures sample rate and duration.

sharplsp.profiler.palette.description: Override profiler colors: critical, hot, warm, memory, memoryHot, memoryWarm, memoryCool, leak, success.

sharplsp.profiler.autoSnapshotOnPause.description: Memory autopilot: while memory tracking is active, automatically take and compare a snapshot every time the debugger pauses.

sharplsp.profiler.autoSnapshot.description: Memory autopilot: while memory tracking is active, automatically take a memory snapshot every few seconds even when the program never pauses.

sharplsp.profiler.autoSnapshotInterval.description: Seconds between automatic memory snapshots when autoSnapshot is enabled.

exceptionPolicy.description: Override the LSP-owned [debug.exceptions] policy from sharplsp.toml for this session.

break_on.description: Choose when to break. Omit to inherit TOML; editor preserves exception checkboxes.

ignore.description: Exact fully qualified CLR types to ignore. Terminal unhandled exceptions still stop.

external_code.description: Show external exceptions at the throw site or nearest user caller.

just_my_code.description: Skip first-chance exceptions inside external code. Inherits shared TOML configuration (default true). Set false with break_on all to inspect every throw.

project.description: The Blazor WebAssembly .csproj/.fsproj to run. Omit to use the project the active document belongs to.

launchProfile.description: The Properties/launchSettings.json profile to run, by name. Omit to use the project's only Project profile.

browser.description: The browser to debug, through VS Code's built-in JavaScript debugger.

url.description: The page to open. Omit to use the address the DevServer announces.

webRoot.description: The directory served URLs map onto. Omit to use the project's wwwroot.

timeout.description: How long the browser debugger waits for the page to load.
